banter.a: Soup's nearly ready. Who's on bowls?
banter.b: I washed them this morning. Ladle's yours.

banter.a: The mites got into the east corridor again.
banter.b: I'll tell the fighters. They love mite season.

banter.a: Remember when this floor had a landlord?
banter.b: Barely. The garden grew right over his office.

banter.a: New verse for the fire tonight?
banter.b: Only if you harmonize this time.

banter.a: The vulture raised 'dungeon fees' again.
banter.b: On what? We don't pay him. Nobody pays him.

banter.a: Somebody left three potions in the share box.
banter.b: And somebody else will need exactly three. It works.

banter.a: The wraith tried to schedule a meeting with me.
banter.b: I hope you declined without comment.

banter.a: Teach-in at the fire after supper?
banter.b: I'll bring the good chalk.

banter.a: Kass took a dent for a stranger today.
banter.b: That's the job. That's the whole job.

banter.a: The tomatoes are winning against the slime.
banter.b: Never doubted them. Fierce little collectivists.

banter.a: Heard the boss floor's portrait gallery doubled.
banter.b: Vanity compounds faster than interest.

banter.a: We should widen the safe room. More travelers lately.
banter.b: I'll draw plans. The commune builds Sunday.

banter.a: A skeleton wandered close, then just... sighed.
banter.b: Even they know. Poor souls signed terrible contracts.

banter.a: Someone new read the wall today and just stood there.
banter.b: That's how it starts. That's exactly how it starts.

banter.a: The coffee's strong tonight.
banter.b: Picket-line strength. As the ancestors brewed.

banter.a: The bard taught the fighters a marching song.
banter.b: I heard. The rats upstairs are terrified of 4/4 time.

banter.a: Sold out of boots at the co-op again.
banter.b: Good. Means people are going places.

banter.a: One day we'll garden on the surface again.
banter.b: One day soon. Keep your seeds ready.

banter.a: Did you schedule the revolution stand-up meeting?
banter.b: It's a sit-down. We're not animals.

banter.a: The mummy upstairs called a mandatory fun event.
banter.b: Attendance: zero. Morale: never higher.

banter.a: There's a portal leaking in the pantry again.
banter.b: Third one this week. LABEL your dimensions.

banter.a: That knight outside still won't admit he's lost.
banter.b: He's been winning face-down for an hour.

banter.a: A gremlin tried to sell me my own boots back.
banter.b: Classic gremlin. ...You didn't buy them, right?

banter.a: Fire's burning clean tonight. Nearly propane-grade.
banter.b: It's wood, friend. But thank you. High praise.

banter.a: I formed a subcommittee on soup thickness.
banter.b: Bold. The turnip caucus will want a say.

banter.a: Science update: the boss remains beatable.
banter.b: Peer-reviewed by everyone who's hit him.

banter.a: Someone put googly eyes on the campfire rocks.
banter.b: And morale is UP. Motion to keep them. Carried.

banter.a: The wraith scheduled me for a one-on-one.
banter.b: Decline it with a counter-meeting. Attendees: nobody.

banter.a: The mud collective ratified a new flag.
banter.b: Let me guess. It's mud.

banter.a: Do we have a five-year plan?
banter.b: Soup, solidarity, repeat. It scales.
